defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Black Apoxia
offensiveAbilities.description:
The target can't recover from the fatigued condition caused by black apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 1 and Fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 Drained 2 and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead

offensiveAbilities.name: Brawling Critical
offensiveAbilities.description: When the kurobozu scores a critical hit with an unarmed attack, the target must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sagebane
offensiveAbilities.description:
When the kurobozu damages a living creature with an unarmed Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Further damage dealt by the kurobozu resets the duration to 1 minute and increases the stupefied value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of stupefied 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Steal Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The kurobozu is adjacent to a living creature that is Paralyzed, Slowed, Stunned, or Unconscious

Effect The kurobozu leans over and sucks the breath from the target, who must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save. Regardless of the result, the creature is exposed to black apoxia and its breath reeks of carrion for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't speak for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes Sickened 2 and can't speak for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature falls Unconscious and begins suffocating.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stunning Flurry
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The kurobozu makes two unarmed Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses, and the target must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Stunned 1 (or Stunned 3 on a critical failure); this save has the incapacitation trait.
